decisions.statement: The pages written are the pages of that page type and of every page type beneath it.
A key the page type no longer declares goes from every page holding it.
A page type no page of which holds the key is refused rather than left as no edit.
A count handed in holds how many pages the key goes from.
A run handed no count takes the key from every page holding it.
A key the page type requires is refused rather than taken away.
A page holding no such key is passed over rather than written.
One page refused refuses the whole change.
A refusal over a page names that page.
A key mistyped is caught here by no page of that page type holding the key.
The edits are worked out by the change reached.
That change acts on a page type, as this one does.
That change is reached through the runner rather than by an import.
Nothing here works out a body of its own.
Nothing here reads a page's own body.

definition: one key taken off every page of one page type, with its values
